```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (A B C : Set α) (h₁ : A ⊆ B) (h₂ : B ⊆ C) : A \ C = ∅ := by
  have h3 : A ⊆ C := subset.trans h₁ h₂
  intro x
  intro h1 : x ∈ A
  exact h3.mp h1
  rw [set.diff_eq]
  exact eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem.2 (fun x => fun h1 => fun h2 => false.elim (h3.mp h1) h2)
```
